description: TTS voiceover generation service - integrate a text-to-speech API that converts UGC script sections into natural-sounding voiceover audio. This is the critical missing piece between script generation and video rendering.
steps: Create apps/web/src/lib/tts/generate.ts - a TTS service module that calls OpenAI's TTS API (via the existing NEXT_PUBLIC_CREATE_BASE_URL proxy or direct OpenAI endpoint). Accept text content and voice settings (voice, speed), return an audio buffer (MP3). Include types for voice options (alloy, echo, fable, onyx, nova, shimmer).
Create apps/web/src/lib/tts/types.ts - shared types: TTSVoice, TTSRequest, TTSResult with audioUrl and durationSec fields.

Create apps/web/src/lib/tts/script-to-audio.ts - takes a full UGC script object (hook, problem, solution, demo, socialProof, cta), concatenates sections with natural pause timing between them, generates a single voiceover audio file via the TTS service, and returns the audio URL (uploaded to object storage) plus per-section timing markers (start/end seconds for each script section). These timing markers drive the video composition later.

Create apps/web/src/app/api/tts/route.ts - POST endpoint that accepts { text, voice?, speed? }, calls the TTS service, uploads the result to object storage (key: tts/<userId>/<jobId>.mp3), and returns { audioUrl, durationSec }. Apply auth, rate limiting (consumeRateLimit with 'ai.tts' event, 20/hour), and quota check.

Create apps/web/src/lib/tts/generate.test.ts - unit tests for the TTS module: test script section concatenation logic, pause insertion timing calculations, and error handling. Mock the fetch call to the TTS API.

Add migration apps/web/migrations/0006_ugc_pipeline.sql - add ugc_projects table (id, user_id, product_url, product_data JSONB, script JSONB, tts_audio_url, tts_timing JSONB, video_assets JSONB, render_job_id, status TEXT, created_at, updated_at) to track the full UGC pipeline state.
acceptance_criteria: apps/web/src/lib/tts/generate.ts exports a generateTTS function that accepts text and returns audio buffer
apps/web/src/lib/tts/script-to-audio.ts exports scriptToAudio that processes a full UGC script into timed voiceover audio
POST /api/tts route compiles with no type errors, uses auth + rate limiting + storage upload pattern
Unit tests for timing logic pass (yarn workspace web test)
Migration 0006 creates ugc_projects table with all required columns
yarn workspace web typecheck passes with no errors
